title: Croatian Green Bean Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Croatia, made with fresh green beans and a hint of citrus.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrot and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the green beans, lemon juice, and thyme. Stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the green beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
